title: "Not by might … but by my Spirit": Zerubbabel's hands will finish the house (Zech 4:6–10)
speaker: The LORD (through the interpreting angel)
description: The great mountain will become a plain before Zerubbabel; he will bring out the capstone; his hands laid the foundation and will finish the house; let no one despise the day of small things.
in_text_interpretation: The completion is tied to a named person and a known building; the text gives no date.

interpretations.label: Fulfilled when the Temple was completed under Darius (515 BC)
interpretations.summary: Textual reasoning: Zerubbabel is named and the house is the Temple then under construction. Historical evidence: Ezra 6:15 records completion in Adar of Darius's sixth year, with the elders prospering through Zechariah's prophesying (6:14). Objection: Ezra 6 does not name Zerubbabel at the completion.
